sources.snippet: ViT Base Oxford IIIT Pets is a fine-tuned version of the Vision Transformer model for pet image classification. Based on the pre-trained ViT-Base architecture, it is specifically optimized for recognizing 37 pet breeds. It is suitable for pet identification applications, smart album classification, and animal conservation research.

sources.title: Vit Base Oxford Iiit Pets - AI Model Insights & Benchmarks
sources.snippet: This model is a fine-tuned version of a pre-trained Vision Transformer (google/vit-base-patch16-224) for image classification on the Oxford-IIIT Pet Dataset. It uses transfer learning to adapt a generic vision model to identify 37 different cat and dog breeds.
